title: Kamailio World 2025 – A Preview Of Sessions
html:
The details of many sessions accepted for Kamailio World Conference 2025 have been published, a couple more to be added in the near future — they are available at:

  • https://www.kamailioworld.com/k2025/schedule/

The topics cover many areas of interest for real time communications, from security to scalability, Web3 services, telecom and 5/6G, WebRTC, and next generation emergency services, with speakers coming from across the world.

Expect another edition with excellent technical content about RTC and great opportunities for networking!
